name: Raffles
overview: Scripture teaches that the pursuit of wealth through dishonest or greedy means is condemned, as seen in the call for fairness in judgment and measures (Leviticus 19:35) and warnings against greed that troubles one's own household (Proverbs 15:27). Wealth gained by vanity or oppression is unstable and leads to want (Proverbs 13:11; 22:16), while the casting of lots is ultimately under the sovereign control of the Lord (Proverbs 16:33). The love of silver and abundance is portrayed as insatiable and vain (Ecclesiastes 5:10), emphasizing the need for contentment and trust in God's provision rather than reliance on chance or unrighteous gain.
